faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions

items.q: How do I add a product to the shopping cart?
items.a: Find the product you want, click 'View Offers' to compare prices from different stores, then click 'Add to Cart' next to your preferred store.
Payment on Bastah is cash on delivery only. Electronic payment options are not currently supported. You pay the merchant directly upon receiving your order.
Delivery time depends on the individual store and your area. Delivery fees and times are determined separately by each store and shown during checkout.
You can request order cancellation before the store confirms it. Go to 'My Orders' in your account and select the order to cancel.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: You can track your order status from 'My Orders' in your profile. You will also receive notifications whenever your order status changes.

items.q: How do I become a seller on Bastah?
items.a: Click 'Sell with Bastah' in the navigation bar, create a merchant account, and submit your store details. Your shop is active as soon as registration succeeds.

policies.title: Our Policies
policies.subtitle: Read our policies carefully to understand your rights and responsibilities

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: At Bastah, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. We only collect necessary information to run the service and improve your experience. We never sell your data to third parties. You have the right to request deletion of your account and data at any time.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: By using the Bastah platform, you agree to the following terms: use the platform for legitimate purposes only, provide accurate information during registration, and respect other buyers and sellers. Bastah reserves the right to suspend any account that violates these terms.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.content: Buyers may request to return a product within 48 hours of receipt if it is damaged or does not match its description. Returns are coordinated directly with the respective merchant. Bastah mediates any disputes between buyer and seller.
